title: Ronne AI Marketplace
description: Find what’s reviewed and released, and install it with rmk.

waiting.title: Waiting for you
waiting.drafts: You have {count, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}} in progress.
waiting.changes: {count, plural, one {# submission of yours needs} other {# submissions of yours need}} changes.
waiting.review: {count, plural, one {# submission waits} other {# submissions wait}} for review.

empty.title: Nothing is published yet.
empty.how: Items arrive in three steps: someone submits one, a moderator reviews and approves it, and it’s released as a version. Then it’s in the catalogue, ready to install with <mono>rmk</mono>.
empty.others: Submit an item or ask a moderator.
empty.root: Start here: create a scope for your items, then submit the first one.

token.title: Create an access token
token.text: A token lets rmk act as you. You make it once and can revoke it any time.

connect.title: Connect rmk
connect.text: Install rmk, then sign in to this registry from your terminal.
connect.token: Or with the token you made:

install.title: Install your first item
install.text: Pick an item in the catalogue. Every item page shows its install command.

draft.title: Start a draft
draft.text: Have a skill, rule or agent of your own? Send it here as a draft to share it.

setUp.title: You’re set up
setUp.text: rmk is connected and you’ve installed an item. This goes away on your next visit; bring it back from Account any time.

noScope.text: This registry has no scope yet. Create one so people can submit items.
